name: VidIQ
tagline: VidIQ is a YouTube optimization toolkit that uses AI to suggest titles, thumbnails, and tags based on what is trending in a creator niche. It scores video SEO before publishing and tracks competitor channels so creators can see which topics are gaining traction. YouTubers and video-first influencers use it to plan content and improve discoverability.
